root_causes.cause: rebuild_index() ignored WordPress option persistence failures both when recording running generation and committing final completed index; it could run a native builder without a persisted generation marker, emit completed success despite storage failure, and allow REST HTTP200 with incomplete state.
root_causes.correction: Verify read-back of running-state option before builder, stop/release lock if unavailable; verify final option read-back before emitting completed rebuild event or returning complete. Return bounded storage error status on failed write.

root_causes.cause: Admin handlers used unconditional index_rebuild_finished or repair_complete notices even when rebuild was busy/failed or repair partially failed; repair stale-index option update failure was marked successful.
root_causes.correction: Admin rebuild notices follow actual complete/busy/failed states. Admin repair notice requires complete operation and persisted repair journal. Stale-index repair verifies option read-back and reports partial on failure.
